item.title: llama.cpp Mixed KV Cache on RTX 5060 Ti: q8_0/q4_0 Test
item.description: On an RTX 5060 Ti, llama.cpp's default CUDA build sent mixed q8_0/q4_0 Flash Attention to CPU; one build flag restored CUDA and an 86x PP gap.

item.title: PyTorch 2.13 on RTX 5060 Ti: cu126 vs cu130 vs cu132
item.description: All three PyTorch 2.13 wheels saw my RTX 5060 Ti, but cu126 mixed working dot/GEMM paths with missing native CUDA kernels.

item.title: torch.cuda.is_available() Returns False on WSL2: 4 Tested Causes
item.description: I tested four reasons torch.cuda.is_available() returns False on WSL2: a CUDA 13 driver mismatch, CPU-only wheel, hidden GPU, and wrong Python.
